title: Data tables missing scope on th (admin, game-page chart tables); minor reflow overflow at 320px [1.3.1 Info and Relationships]
expected: th cells carry scope="col"/"row"; page does not scroll horizontally at 320px.
actual: Admin tables and the hidden chart-data table on game pages have <th> without scope (axe th-has-data-cells needs-review on admin). At 320px /game scrollWidth is 323 and /admin 321 (3 px / 1 px horizontal scroll). 360px passes everywhere, tap targets all >= 44px, and no 360 horizontal scroll.
